content.body: Hey for yesterdays truncation conversation - as in what should screen readers read on truncated text? - I think the best solution here is if screen readers can say "text clipped" in the end, because truncation could be truncated very very long text which is irrelevant (i.e. complete articles when reading)
meaning that get too much text, rather than being able to effectively read a page (imagine having to read an entire newspaper - rather than choosing which article you read in a newspaper)
I don't know if this is possible
I guess the Aria team will come back with an answer
